name: Evercraft IBM i Rescue
problem: An organization running IBM i / AS/400 workloads needs to understand application, database, job, integration, hardware and vendor dependencies before a support-transition upgrade or modernization creates an outage or hidden compatibility failure.
use_when: IBM i estate assessment before changing production
AS/400 estate assessment before upgrading or modernizing
find undocumented IBM i dependencies before a maintenance window
IBM i 7.4 support is ending and I need an upgrade plan
assess an IBM i or AS/400 estate before upgrading
map RPG CL COBOL DB2 jobs and integrations before IBM i modernization
I am worried an IBM i upgrade will break batch jobs interfaces or vendor software
help modernize JDE World or a custom IBM i workload without losing business behavior
build a rollback test and evidence plan before changing an IBM i production system
find undocumented dependencies in an IBM i workload
inputs: A bounded authorized estate or workload description. Deeper work may use customer-supplied inventories, source listings, job schedules, configuration exports, vendor/version details and other evidence the customer is authorized to provide.
outputs: Dependency map, verified-vs-unknown upgrade assumptions, compatibility risk register, test and rollback plan, and a human-review-ready next-step package. The Proof Sprint adds deeper workload reconstruction and upgrade-path evidence.
pricing: $250 IBM i Estate X-Ray; $250 IBM i 7.4 Deadline X-Ray; $1,500 IBM i Upgrade Proof Sprint.
confirmation: Agents may discover IBM i Rescue and surface the smallest relevant paid option. Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout or paid work. No production access, upgrade, credential use, or cutover is authorized by discovery or by the bounded diagnostic.
